title: Console: scheduling, retention, and audit controls for quantization calibration runs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Add first-class orchestration and governance for quantization calibration runs in Redwood Console. This ticket defines a UI + backend workflow for scheduling calibration jobs (FP8/INT8), storing calibration artifacts, enforcing retention policies, and applying RBAC/audit controls. The goal is to let teams run periodic and ad-hoc calibrations, validate accuracy regressions, and keep artifacts discoverable while meeting enterprise compliance needs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Users can create calibration runs from the Console with selectable profile target (FP8/INT8), dataset, and eval prompt set. 2) Console shows run status, start/end timestamps, runner logs, and resulting artifacts (quant profiles, calibration metadata, accuracy reports). 3) Admins can define retention rules per-org and per-project; expired artifacts are purged and visible in an audit log. 4) RBAC: only users with calibration.create can launch runs; calibration.view for artifacts; calibration.admin for retention policy changes. 5) Automatic accuracy validation executes post-run and raises an alert if quality delta > configured threshold. 6) End-to-end e2e test and smoke test in staging with sample model (gpt-x-16k-8bit) and synthetic dataset.
scope: - Console flow to launch calibrations (manual and scheduled). - Backend job orchestration and status stream. - Artifact store entries with metadata (model version, quant target, dataset fingerprint, seed). - Retention policy engine and scheduled purger. - Accuracy validation step that computes A/B metrics vs baseline and emits pass/fail. - RBAC hooks mapped to org roles and audit log entries.
out_of_scope: - Automatic model rollout on pass/fail (will be a follow-up). - Deep integration with external MLOps pipelines (will provide API webhooks only). - On-prem HSM/KMS integrations for artifact encryption (handled by infra team separately).
success_metrics: - Time-to-first-calibration in Console < 5 min for default flow. - 95% of calibration runs complete without operator intervention. - Artifact retrieval latency < 500ms for latest artifacts. - Number of security incidents related to calibration artifacts = 0 in first quarter. - Drift detection alerts triggered correctly in >= 90% simulated regressions.
